 Financial rewards are significant, with a competitive 70% billing split, initial guarantees, and structured incentives. This model is specifically designed to balance high patient volume with the financial security of a focused, well-managed business environment. 

 Beyond the financial benefits, the practice places a high premium on doctor satisfaction and professional growth.
